name: 鳥吉
description:
コロナ自粛が暇すぎて、2020のゴールデンウィークからお絵描きを始めました。取り敢えずその時興味があるものをテーマに色々描きます pixiv→http://pixiv.net/users/54504803
【Commission】skeb→https://skeb.jp/@SddcARCxyjLYx2l

works.body:
Greetings! I hope you are doing well.

I would like to request you to draw a character for me. The character is Agria (アグリア) from Tales of Xillia (テイルズオブエクシリア)

She is wearing her Christmas Costume from Tales of the Rays. (https://imgchest.com/p/9p4n3l95b7n) (I have also included Model pictures for more references if needed!) 

I would like a dynamic or action pose. I will leave the rest of the details free for you to decide. Please do something you are comfortable with.

For her weapon I have separate references for it. It is a very unique weapon. Examples: (https://cdn.imgchest.com/files/w7w6cqvozay.jpg) (https://cdn.imgchest.com/files/wye3cwpdo94.png) (https://cdn.imgchest.com/files/k739ck6mgj7.jpg)

Thank you for your consideration.

https://imgchest.com/p/9p4n3l95b7n

Hi! I'd like to request a romantic kissing scene between these characters from FEH.
Veronica (ヴェロニカ):
https://guide.fire-emblem-heroes.com/00001005000881-2/
Alfonse (アルフォンス):
https://guide.fire-emblem-heroes.com/00001001001133-2/
They have a "former enemies becoming lovers" dynamic.

Alfonse (185cm) gently embraces Veronica (155cm), slightly lifting her off the ground. He treats her with care and affection. Veronica is so immersed in the kiss and overwhelmed by her emotions that her delicate body runs out of strength. As such, Veronica's legs, wings, and one of her arms are dangling loosely. However, she can still caress Alfonse with her other arm. If possible, part of the red hosiery and golden high-heeled shoes that Veronica wears under her dress must be in-frame. The scene takes place in a royal castle's lush garden.

I'll leave the composition details up to you, so that this concept can be illustrated as beautifully as possible. Veronica's dainty beauty must be a main priority.

https://www.intsys.co.jp/goods/fireemblem-figure/06.html

If you like, I would please like to request an illustration of Nina from Fire Emblem Fates (JP: エポニーヌ (FEif)):
Resplendent Nina Fire Emblem Heroes (FEH) https://imgur.com/a/CDfOOPW
You may pick the pose.
She is a Fujoshi so normally she has a lustful expression, draw her with a lustful expression as if she's fantasizing

Greetings.

 I would like to request you to draw a character for me.

The character is Marni (マロン) from Fire Emblem Engage (ファイアーエムブレム エンゲージ).

I would like a dynamic or action pose. I will leave the rest of the details free for you to decide. Please do something you are comfortable with.

For her weapon I would like for her to use her Hurricane Axe (かぜの大斧) as shown in these examples: (https://cdn.imgchest.com/files/j7kzc2pgkk7.jpg) (https://cdn.imgchest.com/files/d7ogcdaj6wy.png)

References for the character will be posted here as well. Thank you for your consideration.

https://imgchest.com/p/na7kzlgvm78

https://imgchest.com/p/na7kzlgvm78

Eclat (エクラ) and Seidr (セイズ) from Fire Emblem Heroes (FEH) are sharing a romantic kiss during the New Year's celebration, with a beautiful night sky and fireworks in the background.
Seidr must be wearing the outfit from these reference materials:
https://guide.fire-emblem-heroes.com/00007001001041-2/
Eclat has his usual appearance wearing a hood.
Seidr and Eclat have the same height. Seidr lovingly kisses Eclat as Eclat gently hugs her.

Some important final details: For romantic effect, there must be some hearts and stars floating around Eclat's head to represent that he is utterly enraptured by the kiss.
In addition, one copy of the following symbol must also be floating around Eclat's head:
https://files.catbox.moe/ecnpae.png

The symbol represents Seidr's "Time's Grip" (時の陥穽) power, which freezes or loops time. The idea is that this is a neverending New Year's kiss.

I'd like to share the illustration on SNS (Reddit). I'd be giving credit to the artist and linking to your profile.

Please draw Scabiosa from Fire Emblem Heroes.
https://i.imgur.com/Hb1w5Y9.png
Draw her kissing the Summoner Eclat from Fire Emblem Heroes
https://fireemblem.fandom.com/wiki/Kiran/Gallery
The summoner is masculine, but has a hood over the eyes.

Scabiosa is cool, but also cute. Draw her wings, the vines in her hair, and her makeup. Her skin is very pale, and her ears are pointed, but her ears are usually not visible. She is cold and distant, but is trying to be affectionate in the moment.

https://fireemblem.fandom.com/wiki/Triandra/Gallery

Hello, I really enjoy your art and would like to make a request!

Character: Morgan from Fire Emblem Awakening (left image of reference).  

Outfit: Please have Morgan wear Lucina's queen outfit (right image of reference).  

Expression/Pose/Background: If possible, I would like a dynamic or action pose. I will leave the rest of the details free for you to decide. Please do something you are comfortable with.  

Important information:  
- Morgan should have the same blue colored hair and eyes as Lucina (the women from the right image of reference).  
- I would also like the sword and shield from the reference image to be included. If possible, please avoid covering too much of the body behind the shield.  

For more helpful reference images and inspiration, please see past examples I requested:  
https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/15vlgpWHqhG_XyIYrZw4_dPvMcCHr6Q8s   

Thank you for your time.

https://imgur.com/a/TSAs1uR

Draw a new costume you would like "Hazel" to wear! Any pose or situation is OK! Use your imagination to make her shine!

https://imgur.com/a/uL1YBJg

https://imgur.com/a/QsJIXPV

Nice to meet you.
I am contacting you with a request.

I would like to request an illustration of VTuber "Lily Crawford".
Here is the full body drawing.

If possible, please use 16:9 ratio.

Nice to meet you. Your art is very cute, I like it a lot! I would like to request a drawing of my original character. She is an energetic girl who is 144cm tall and loves various types of sports.

I would like to see her in the following outfit: https://imgur.com/a/NAPxlzF

Pose, expression, etc. are up to you. Additional character reference is in the URL below. Thank you!

https://sta.sh/02fpmniqfjnd

The character I would like to ask you to draw is the mascot character of my site again, and she will be wearing a green jersey, gym uniform and bloomers.
https://twitter.com/Funakiya/status/1444135179837054976

I would like the situation to be of my child playing with a shiba-inu (a Japanese bush dog).
I will leave the details to you.


I would like to use it only within the scope of introduction on my site in order to avoid introduction on social networking sites and twitter freeze.

Nice to meet you!
I requested this because I was interested in your drawing pattern.
If you don't mind, would it be possible for me to ask you to draw our OC, "Rikuzuki Usagi"?
For your reference, the setting is as follows, but you can draw freely.
Mutsuki Usagi
Rikuzuki Usagi (陸月 兎子)

A girl with pigtails, black hair and eyes, and a hair dress decorated with stars.
She is curious and good-natured.

She always carries Boo, a white rabbit, with her.
She is the only one who can see Boo, and no one but Boo can touch him.

She has the ability to interfere with the world and time, and can find herself in another world line or another time axis that matches certain conditions and send images (limited to simple figures such as zeros and x's) telepathically.

It is difficult for the sender to send the image many times in a row because of the dramatic discomfort involved.
The recipient has no inbox or rejection settings, so he or she feels as if his or her consciousness is suddenly jammed. If a large number of messages are received simultaneously from different world lines or different time axes, the recipient will lose consciousness with a nosebleed.

She herself has no further special powers, but her companion Boo is no exception.
Boo, like her, has the ability to interfere with the world and time, but it goes beyond the level of sending telepathic messages and randomly rewrites the world (time) itself.

Since Boo's intelligence is about that of a 5-6 year old child, if left unchecked, she will use her abilities at will, and the way the world (time) is distorted without limit.
If the distortion becomes too severe, it will even affect another world line (time axis), and if that happens, he will receive a large number of warnings from himself in the other world line (time axis), so he has no choice but to watch over Boo so that he does not use his powers carelessly.

If Boo inadvertently uses his power, we will have no choice but to ask him to use his power several more times to correct the distortion, but since it is only an act of correcting distortion by distortion, it cannot be completely restored.

Since he is not known as a person of ability, no one has given him a second name. He calls himself "The Wizard of Time," "The Watcher," etc., but these are only self-proclaimed names.
He is a "wizard of time" and "watcher," but these are only self-proclaimed names.
I am planning to use this for all my personal activities (illustrations for novels, introduction of characters on SNS and personal websites, announcements of personal activities, etc.).
If it is convenient for you, I would appreciate it.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-CVMYZAOuQisUoQ5mG0NPRuoLmySIiQg

Hello!

I would love to ask to get art for a Vtuber love of mine Auroera, she is a flirtatious and caring succubus, with antlers and wings. If possible, I would love if you can give her a flirting, yet playful pose similar to the one I have in the reference.

Art may be used for thumbnails, wallpapers, etc. Proper credit will given. Thank you for considering.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1DwryTA7B7BGVT9iV_IMANu8b_lfMbndF
